scenes.text: She lived alone and kept a tidy fridge.
On Monday there was a note on the milk: you forgot the eggs.
She had forgotten the eggs. She laughed it off.
On Friday the note said: you are reading this on Friday.
It was the only note she had not written herself.
Follow for more Quiet Horror Files.
